name: Fujiwara no Tadamichi
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 76); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1164.

poems.title: When rowing on the open sea
poems.author: Fujiwara no Tadamichi
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 76
poems.text:
When rowing on the open sea,
The waves, all capped with white,
Roll onward, like the fleecy clouds
With their resistless might;
Truly a wondrous sight!

poems.title: 76. わたの原 漕ぎ出でて見れば 久方の (Wata no hara kogiidete mireba hisakata no)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Tadamichi
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 詞花集
poems.text:
わたの原 漕ぎ出でて見れば 久方の
雲居にまがふ 沖つ白浪
